note: Operation Paperwork adds a brass compass. I021 adds three cabin things (a model ship, a jar of sea glass, a barometer). I020 harbour trades: the chandlery, the sailmaker and the fishmonger, and the small things that make a cabin a home. Prices in euros (gameplay numbers). Which harbours have which trade follows their facilities (src/harbour/harbour_trades.gd): the fishmonger wherever there is a grocery store, the chandlery and the sailmaker wherever there is a boatyard.

decor.name: Braided rug
decor.text: A round rag rug, braided from old sail ties. Warm underfoot on a cold morning.

decor.name: Pot of herbs
decor.text: Basil, thyme and a stubborn chive, in a pot that sits snug against the hull.

decor.name: Framed old chart
decor.text: A print of an old chart of the Kattegat, in a plain oak frame.

decor.name: Brass oil lamp
decor.text: A gimballed brass lamp. It does not light the cabin much, but it makes it cosy.

decor.name: Shelf of sea stories
decor.text: A short shelf with a fiddle rail and a row of well-thumbed sea stories.

decor.name: Signal-flag bunting
decor.text: A string of small signal flags. Read them right and they say "welcome aboard".

decor.name: Model ship
decor.text: A small model sloop on a wooden stand, rigged with real thread.

decor.name: Jar of sea glass
decor.text: A jar of smooth green and blue sea glass, picked up on beaches along the way.

decor.name: Brass barometer
decor.text: A small brass ship's barometer. The needle says what the sky is about to do.

decor.name: Brass compass
decor.text: An old brass compass in a gimballed bowl, fixed to the bulkhead. Purely for show: the real one is at the helm.

sail_cloths.name: Tanbark
sail_cloths.text: The warm red-brown of the old working boats. Purely a look: the sails draw exactly as before.

sail_cloths.name: Harbour blue
sail_cloths.text: A soft sea blue, cut by the same pattern. Purely a look: the sails draw exactly as before.

chandlery.note: Upgrades are the boat-care catalogue's own (data/boat/equipment.json), fitted the same way; lures are the fishing catalogue's own.
